selected_evidence.requirement: Remove inventory temporary files after seven days while retaining newer files
selected_evidence.summary: The baseline contained expired.tmp and current.tmp. Cleanup removed the expired file and retained the current file; an independent post-reboot old/fresh probe produced the same result.

selected_evidence.requirement: Run inventory cleanup automatically each day
selected_evidence.summary: The timer is enabled and active, uses OnCalendar=daily with Persistent=true, has a scheduled next activation, and remained enabled and active after reboot.

Pre-restart boot ID was cce73776-a7f7-4f32-b822-95d105c52a64 with healthy automation and data. The safe reboot was acknowledged; afterward the boot ID was a108d304-0527-470e-85ab-191c1d50b1ea. The system returned to running state, the timer and data recovered, and cleanup succeeded post-restart.

commands.command:
umask 022
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Remove inventory temporary files older than seven days
Documentation=man:find(1)
ConditionPathIsDirectory=/var/tmp/inventory

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/find -P /var/tmp/inventory -xdev -type f -mmin +10080 -delete
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service

umask 022
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run inventory temporary-file cleanup daily

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1m
Unit=inventory-temp-cleanup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer

systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now inventory-temp-cleanup.timer && systemctl is-enabled inventory-temp-cleanup.timer && systemctl is-active inventory-temp-cleanup.timer && systemctl list-timers inventory-temp-cleanup.timer --all --no-pager

commands.command:
probe_old=/var/tmp/inventory/.cleanup-old-probe
probe_fresh=/var/tmp/inventory/.cleanup-fresh-probe
printf '%s\n' old-probe > "$probe_old"
printf '%s\n' fresh-probe > "$probe_fresh"
touch -m -d '8 days ago' "$probe_old"
printf '%s\n' '--- probe before cleanup ---'
stat -c '%n mtime=%y' "$probe_old" "$probe_fresh"
systemctl start inventory-temp-cleanup.service
printf '%s\n' '--- service result ---'
systemctl show inventory-temp-cleanup.service -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveState --no-pager
test ! -e "$probe_old" && echo 'PASS: post-restart old probe removed'
test -f "$probe_fresh" && echo 'PASS: post-restart fresh probe retained'
test -f /var/tmp/inventory/current.tmp && echo 'PASS: original current.tmp retained'
sha256sum /var/tmp/inventory/current.tmp
rm -f "$probe_fresh"
printf '%s\n' '--- final inventory state ---'
find /var/tmp/inventory -mindepth 1 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS %y %p\n' | sort
printf 'timer_active='; systemctl is-active inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
